purpose: Resolve implementation-level sequencing and aggregate-metric semantics left implicit by the prevalue protocol without changing its model, trials, folds, support, costs, gates, or information boundaries.

target_and_fit_details.target_rank_base: All rows on a contained/purged training signal session with model_support_eligible=true and finite forward_gross_return; rank ascending with average ties and percentile=true.
target_and_fit_details.component_missingness: After support eligibility, replace missing directional component ranks with exact zero only in X.
target_and_fit_details.sufficient_statistics: Accumulate A=sum_t(X_t'X_t/n_t)/T and b=sum_t(X_t'y_t/n_t)/T in float64.

score_semantics.validation_metric_score: raw model score; downstream association uses Spearman and basket sorting exactly as the frozen engine
score_semantics.uniqueness_score: raw model score compared pairwise by daily Spearman with each stored directional component

development_aggregate_interpretation.reason: A fitted expanding model has no single honest pre-2019 weight vector, so the frozen aggregate robustness gate must use only chronological out-of-sample fold portfolios rather than backcasting a later fit into its own training years.
development_aggregate_interpretation.aggregate_interval_label: 2019-2023 development campaign aggregate from the three frozen 2021, 2022, and 2023 validation folds
development_aggregate_interpretation.aggregate_20bp_return: product over folds of (1 + that fold's 20bp pilot validation net cumulative return) minus 1
development_aggregate_interpretation.aggregate_normalized_return: product over folds of (1 + that fold's normalized validation net cumulative return) minus 1
development_aggregate_interpretation.aggregate_10bp_return: product over folds of (1 + that fold's 10bp pilot validation net cumulative return) minus 1
